To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(1) the phrase-based and Ngram-based SMT models complement each other; (2) the N-gram-based models can be used as an auxiliary model to improve the quality of phrase-based translation; (3) the auxiliary model can be used in a variety of ways to improve translation, and (4) the best way to use the auxiliary model depends on the language pair and the training data size.

(1) phrase-based models can be significantly improved by using N-gram translation and reordering, (2) the improvement is larger for language pairs with more translation errors, (3) the gain is larger for longer sentences.
